correctness.rationale: The frozen Finding (RESULT.md line 16) says the fixed-letter frame-validity theory increases strictly with the leaf count; it decreases under inclusion, as the proof itself correctly says at line 48. With one letter, p→Box p is valid on F_0 and false at the F_1 root when p holds only there. All the operation counts, collapse and sharpness are otherwise supported: a leaf only observes its color, and a root observes its color a and the set S of leaf colors. A uniform root is identified with the leaf type of color a; a nonuniform root detects every color in S by Diamond(chi_c and Box chi_c) because the root cannot witness the test. Depth zero has q types; depth one observes the root color and any set of at most k off-colors, while depth two distinguishes every nonempty S of size at most k (counting the uniform singleton as the terminal type, not an extra type). Boolean combinations of the characteristic formulas give the stated powersets. The single-world case and the q=1 case collapse at depth zero; for q>=2 and k>=2, supports {b} and {a,b} at a root of color a give the same depth-one palette and different depth-two types. At every step t to t+1 below q a new nonuniform support of size t+1 refutes the negation of its characteristic formula; duplicating colors, or using uniform assignments for t=0, embeds the old types in the new. This proves strict theory decrease and both stabilization cutoffs. Replay: RESULT.md lines 24–48. The first-step counterexample was also checked over all Boolean assignments on F_0 and F_1; the uploaded verify.py and VERIFICATION.md were inspected, not executed.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: On F_k every nonempty strict-successor support of size <=k is freely realizable by duplicating colors, and the uniform singleton per root color is replaced by the old terminal point. Thus the earlier complete list gives exactly q times the truncated positive-size binomial sum. At depth one, truncate off-colors at k to obtain q times the other truncated sum. A new definable type yields a strict validity loss by negating its characteristic formula. Supports reach maximum q, off-color palettes q−1, yielding exactly the last-leaf gap; no new type construction or independent obstruction is needed.
